title: Taijutsu Stances
body:
Syntax: kihon dachi | neko ashi dachi | sanchin dachi

Description: Taijutsu class unlocks Kihon Dachi at level 5 (+2 damage roll, -2 AC), Neko Ashi Dachi at level 15 (+2 hit roll, -4 AC), and Sanchin Dachi at level 30 (+4 damage roll). Only one stance can be active. Change or leave a stance outside combat; using the active stance again returns to normal. Activation costs stamina. Your stance remains active across reconnects. See 'aff' or 'score'.

Date: 2026-09-26
